text:
```yaml
name: E2E Portal Test

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  e2e-portal:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: cargo build --release

      - name: Run Playwright UI tests
        run: |
          npm install
          npx playwright test

      - name: Run traffic verification scripts
        run: cargo run --bin traffic_verification_script

      - name: Add SOCKS5 UDP support to imix_connect
        run: |
          cd imix_connect
          git apply ../path/to/socks5_udp_support.patch
          cargo build --release
```

Please note that you need to replace `../path/to/socks5_udp_support.patch` with the actual path to your patch file or adjust the commands accordingly if the patch is not used. Also, ensure that the `traffic_verification_script` binary exists and is correctly configured in your project.
